posts.text: I have been getting feedback on Maithon Alloys for > 20 years in our closed friends group discussion. Few of them had business relations with them. The Sector and the company is a consintent cash generator although is subject to business cycles as well. Any investor needs to understand the business cycle factor. They are super cash rich and use the funds to buy raw materials at lower price at drawdown cycle and that is used to generate extra profitability at the uptick in the market cycles.
